independence_declaration.statement: I am domain-reviewer, and I authored nothing in the reviewed scope: sources, analysis, register, agent definitions, gate or agent tooling, or delivery docs. My only writes are this round-24 record, its verifications sidecar and narrative, and my own evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/domain/round-24/. I formed this verdict without reading any other round-24 review record, and none existed in my view. The only earlier review material I read was my own round-23 domain record, findings, verifications and scripts, which I reused and re-ran.

checks_run.actual: Main HEAD is 79fb0f8 ('freeze round-24 candidate'), shallow=false, and the candidate is sha256:f0f3a93a1fcf33e58b1d553e39205cc8bc1764407189b69904d2d58e976f351a (91 files).
